opportunities.name: Company account brief: SEC 10-K lookup + Wikipedia + email draft
opportunities.description: For a given company ticker, find its latest 10-K on SEC EDGAR, read HQ/employees/CEO on Wikipedia, and draft an 'Account brief' email to dana@example.com.
steps: Open EDGAR full-text search and type the ticker in the company name box, select the autocomplete suggestion
Open the Form filter and pick 10-K (Annual report) to see latest filing date
Search Wikipedia for the company and open its article
Read HQ, employee count and CEO from the infobox
Open new mail message, set To to dana@example.com
Set Subject to 'Account brief: <Company> (<TICKER>)'
Type body: '<Company>: HQ <city>, <employees> employees, CEO <name>. Latest 10-K filed <date>.'
Send or discard the draft

instances.values: SNOW / Snowflake: HQ Menlo Park, 9,060 employees, CEO Sridhar Ramaswamy, 10-K 2026-03-20
DDOG / Datadog: HQ New York City, 8,100 employees, CEO Olivier Pomel, 10-K 2026-02-18
HUBS / HubSpot: SEC 10-K lookup done; Wikipedia/email part not observed in recording

opportunities.name: Supplier currency quote comparison and local time email
opportunities.description: Compare the USD value of an amount in two currencies on Xe, check supplier city local time on timeanddate, and email procurement the result.
steps: Open Xe currency converter, enter amount A in currency 1 and read USD equivalent
Change currency to currency 2 via the dropdown, enter amount B, read USD equivalent
On timeanddate World Clock search the supplier city and open it to read local time
Open new mail to procurement@example.com
Set Subject 'Quotes: <item>'
Type body '<A> <C1> = <USD1> USD, <B> <C2> = <USD2> USD, cheaper: <C>. Supplier time in <city>: <time> <tz>.'
Send or discard the draft

instances.values: 12500 EUR vs 1950000 JPY, Osaka, CNC enclosures
8200 GBP vs 780000 INR, Pune, Shipping boxes
INR vs CNY comparison (50 INR, 64000 INR -> CNY 14500); incomplete, no email observed

opportunities.name: Two-city time zone sync and holiday avoidance email
opportunities.description: Add two cities in timeanddate Time Zone Converter, read the time difference, find holidays in the remote country for a given month, and email ops a sync note.
steps: Open Time Zones > Time Zone Converter
Search city 1, select the result; search city 2, select the result; read the hour difference
Open Calendar > Holidays, choose the remote country
Open the holiday list for the target month and note dates
Open new mail to ops@example.com
Set Subject 'Sync: <city1> / <city2>, <month>'
Type body '<city2> is <diff> ahead from <city1>. Avoid: <dates>.'
Send or discard the draft

instances.values: San Francisco / Bangalore, India holidays, October; avoid Oct 2 and Oct 20
New York / Berlin, Germany holidays, December; avoid Dec 25 and 26
